name: email
title: Transactional email (Resend)
summary: Send confirmations and internal notifications through Resend, with retries, idempotency and a safe HTML shell.
when: A form or booking should email the visitor a confirmation, or email you a copy.
env: # Server-side only. Without these, sendMail() returns { sent: false, reason: 'unconfigured' }
# and the route carries on: store first, mail second, never lose the row.
# The ONLY place the sender is written. Must be a domain verified in Resend.
# Use a subdomain (mail.example.com) so transactional reputation stays apart from staff mail.
# Where a visitor's reply goes (the sender is a noreply mailbox).
# Where internal copies (new enquiry, new booking) are sent.
# Absolute origin for links inside mail (falls back to Vercel's production URL).
next: Verify a sending domain in Resend, then set RESEND_API_KEY and RESEND_FROM (local .env and Vercel).
